faqs.question: Who can join this batch?
faqs.answer: This batch is specifically designed for students studying in school curriculum aiming to score 95%+ in their school exams while building a strong foundation for future competitive exams (Olympiads, NTSE, JEE, NEET).

faqs.question: Can I watch recorded lectures if I miss a live class?
faqs.answer: Yes! Every single live lecture is recorded and uploaded to your dashboard within 2 hours of completion. You can watch it unlimited times at 1x, 1.25x, 1.5x or 2x speed until your validity expires.

faqs.question: How will my academic doubts be resolved?
faqs.answer: You get 24x7 dedicated doubt support inside the app. Students can take a photo of any question or write their query to receive instant step-by-step video & text solutions from expert teaching assistants.

faqs.question: Will I get physical books or only PDF notes?
faqs.answer: The Regular plan includes high-quality downloadable & printable classroom PDF notes and formula sheets. The Infinity Pro plan includes complete physical printed book kits delivered to your doorstep.

faqs.question: Is there a refund policy available?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer a 100% money-back guarantee within 7 days of batch commencement if you are not fully satisfied with the teaching.
